analysis_boundary: Strict chronology contract 20261122 remains HOLD because one original 2012 mean_greenup=-27 fails DOY 1..366. Do not amend or reinterpret the strict gate.
parent_source_dataset: Adams et al. 2025 Ecology Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.26050390.v2, original file 47109769
scientific_question: Without interpreting a single out-of-calendar original mean_greenup field, what are the logical lower/upper bounds on station-years where the greenup event precedes radar median spring migration passage?
date_gap: d = q50 DOY - greenup DOY on 827 valid source records
logical_bounds: For any category with k classified valid records, total fraction over original N=828 is within [k/828, (k+1)/828]. The 2012 unknown observation contributes either 0 or 1 to its category, never silently treated as missing, present, or moved.
annual_output: 16 annual aggregate records with original n, valid n, unknown n, category k and [k/n,(k+unknown)/n] only. Never original station IDs, source DOYs or original per-site observations.
summary_output: Pooled k, lower/upper fractions on 828; how many original years have majority q50 earlier than greenup under either bound; no p-values, no causal effect and no post hoc subsets.
uncertainty: These are exact finite-sample identification bounds conditional on the 827 valid source rows, not sampling confidence intervals; no statistical bootstrap unless separately declared.
scope_limit: Satellite MODIS mean greenup marker is a retrospective composite, not a confirmed cue at decision time
Bird radar q50 is an assemblage median, not an individual bird decision
One anomalous source value is unclassified rather than corrected, reinterpreted or excluded without accounting for its possible contribution
Ecological predictive null from parent PR415 remains unchanged
No inference on fitness, insect biomass, actual information receipt, actionability or cross-species coordination
Same source as PR415; not a new independent ecological replication
